author: Microsoft
description:
At Cannes Lions 2026, Microsoft Consumer CMO Yusuf Mehdi and bestselling author @melrobbins explore how to navigate the AI era with curiosity, confidence, and purpose. Together, they discuss why so many people feel stuck during periods of change, and why human qualities like empathy, creativity, and lived experience matter more than ever. From practical advice on getting started with AI to an inspiring conversation about overcoming self-doubt, this session is a reminder that technology is most powerful when it helps people achieve more.

Chapters
00:00 - Why change makes people freeze
02:15 - AI and paradox of choice
04:14 - What AI can’t replace
09:23 - The future of AI Agents
12:05 - Friction and how to start
13:34 - Is using AI cheating?
14:30 - Share your story and be cringe
15:10 - You stand in your own way
title: Mel Robbins: "Half the world is stuck… here’s how to move ahead" | Cannes Lions 2026

author: Microsoft
description:
For nearly 160 years, the International Telecommunication Union has helped the world communicate across borders, from the telegraph to the telephone, television, satellite, the internet, and now AI. In this episode of Tools and Weapons, Microsoft's Vice Chair and President Brad Smith sit down with Doreen Bogdan, Secretary-General of the ITU, to discuss why connectivity remains one of the world’s most important foundations for opportunity.

The conversation explores the 2.2 billion people who are still unconnected, the estimated $2.8 trillion needed to connect the world by 2030, and the partnerships required to reach the hardest-to-connect communities. Doreen shares stories from the field, including a refugee camp in Chad where a small computer center gives people access to learning, health care, financial tools, and family connections.

title: Connecting the unconnected | Secretary-General of the ITU Doreen Bogdan-Martin
